aspect: Threat monitoring runs on the same budget as thinking
description: Sustained vigilance consumes the working memory and attention that would otherwise go to work and study. The capacity is finite and it is already committed.
energy_note: Concentration spent before the day starts.

description: A business, a degree, a book, a house all require an assumption of continuity that is not available. The rational move is short-horizon, low-commitment activity - which is also the activity with no compounding returns.
energy_note: Never starting the thing that takes five years.

aspect: Administrative load is a second unpaid job
description: Permits, renewals, appeals, evidence files, embassy appointments, document legalisation. Days per year, every year, drawn from the same hours as the career.
time_note: Days per year on the administration of the hurdles in this file.
energy_note: A second job, unpaid, with no promotion.

aspect: Sleep is the first thing lost, and it is the input to everything
description: Night raids, sirens, blackouts, a phone that might ring, and the folder. Degraded sleep degrades judgement, mood, immune function and output, and it does so invisibly.
energy_note: Everything else, downstream of not sleeping.

aspect: It is scored as a character trait
description: Reduced output is appraised by employers, universities and even families as laziness, lack of ambition, or unreliability. The person receives the judgement, and frequently agrees with it.
energy_note: Judged for capacity that was already spent.

aspect: Which is the closing loop of this entire dataset
description: Conditions are imposed. The conditions reduce output. The reduced output is read as evidence about the person and the people. That evidence is then used to justify the conditions.
energy_note: The circle: made unable, then blamed for it.
